title: Shaken Iced Coffee Frappé with Milk
summary: Instant coffee, sugar and cold water are shaken hard into a dense foam, shaken again with ice, and finished with cold milk poured down the side of the glass.
equipment: cocktail shaker or jam jar with a tight lid (or a milk frother)

ingredients.item: cold whole milk or evaporated milk

steps.title: Shake the foam
steps.text: Shake the coffee, sugar and water hard in a closed shaker for 30-60 seconds until thick and foamy.

steps.title: Add ice
steps.text: Add the ice and shake 1 minute more until very cold.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Tip everything into a tall glass, spooning the last of the foam on top.

steps.title: Add the milk
steps.text: Pour the milk slowly down the tilted glass so the foam floats.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Add a straw and drink at once.

tips: Only instant coffee makes this stable foam; brewed coffee will not.
Decide on the sugar before shaking: it helps the foam set.
Evaporated milk gives a richer, creamier result.
storage: Make and drink fresh; the foam collapses on standing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
